ObjectName.value: U.S. Embassy Donates Books to National Parliamentary Library of Georgia 08

Categories.value: PD US DOS|Richard Norland|National Parliamentary Library of Georgia|2014 in Tbilisi|Georgia (country) photographs taken on 2014-01-15|Relations of Georgia (country) and the United States

ImageDescription.value: January 15, 2014, U.S. Ambassador Richard Norland visited the National Parliamentary Library to donate more than 100 Pulitzer Prize Winning books by American authors to the library’s permanent collection. The Ambassador thanked the director, Giorgi Kekelidze, and the head of public relations, Giorgi Sabanadze, for their tremendous support of Embassy events such as the annual Educational Fair and Millennium Challenge Corporation’s Second Compact reception.

pages.title: File:Les Peintres Cubistes by Guillaume Apollinaire.jpg

ObjectName.value: Les Peintres Cubistes by Guillaume Apollinaire

Categories.value: Guillaume Apollinaire|International Museum Day|Albert Gleizes|National Parliamentary Library of Georgia|Books about art|Items with VRTS permission confirmed|Salome Zurabishvili in 2022|Photographs by Giorgi Abdaladze

ImageDescription.value: Georgian President Salome Zourabichvili gifted books from the personal library of Elene Akhvlediani to the Museum of Books of the Ilia Chavchavadze National Parliamentary Library on International Museum Day. The books, which were purchased personally by the President, include: Du “Cubisme” by Albert Gleizes and Jean Metzinger and Les Peintres Cubistes by Guillaume Apollinaire (May 2022).
